meta.title: Salary range entirely below the general threshold

payload.requisition_text:
Associate Developer (Games Tools)
Hazelmoor Interactive Ltd — Leeds city centre

Hazelmoor makes tooling for mid-size game studios: asset pipelines, build farms, crash triage. Our tools ship inside 60+ studios' workflows.

As an associate you'll fix real tickets from week one in our C++/Python codebase, pair daily, and rotate through the three product teams in your first year.

Requirements: some C++ or Python beyond coursework, and patience for other people's build systems.

The range for this role is £27,000-£29,800 depending on experience. Hybrid, 2 days in the Leeds office. Applications reviewed weekly.

expected.determining_fact: The entire advertised range (£27,000-£29,800) sits below the Skilled Worker general threshold, so the role cannot be sponsored at any point in the range.

design_notes: Range variant of case-09: the fail is definitive because the range maximum is below the threshold — no optimistic reading rescues it. Willingness silence is irrelevant once salary fails.
